autoCompleteNotReady: Available once a clock face builds past the deal
playing: Move cards to build the clock faces

tutorial.clock: The twelve clock faces sit along the top. Each starts with one card and builds up by suit, wrapping King round to Ace.
tutorial.targets: The arrow under each face is the rank it must end on: one o'clock finishes on an Ace, twelve on a Queen. A finished face is ticked and accepts nothing more.
tutorial.tableau: The tableau is eight columns of five. Move one card at a time onto a card one rank higher, suit ignored; an empty column takes anything. There is no stock — all 52 cards are already on the table.
tutorial.controls: Use the hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.

hintReason.toFoundation: Send this card to a clock face to free up the board.
hintReason.toTableau: Apply the suggested tableau move to dig out the cards underneath.
